reason: After reviewing the complete Form 20-F filing for Greenfire Resources Ltd. (fiscal year ended December 31, 2023), no Total Addressable Market (TAM) was disclosed by the company. The filing contains extensive operational and financial information about the company's SAGD thermal oil sands production facilities in Alberta, including detailed reserve data, production metrics, and market positioning. However, Greenfire did not provide any company-disclosed TAM figures for the oil sands market, Canadian heavy oil market, or any other relevant market segments. The document focuses on operational performance, reserves, and financial results rather than addressable market sizing.
